description: The Dynamic Sampling Processor performs adaptive trace sampling using first-match rules-based routing to dynamic samplers. Each sampler produces a known sample rate which is encoded as `ot=th` in W3C TraceState for correct downstream metric weighting.
name: dynamicsamplingprocessor

processor_dynamic_sampling_decision_samp.description: Distribution of effective sample rates produced per rule. Useful for detecting adaptive samplers settling at unexpected rates.

processor_dynamic_sampling_decision_trig.description: Number of trace decisions made, labelled by which event triggered the decision (root_span, trace_timeout).

processor_dynamic_sampling_traces_active.description: Number of traces currently in the accumulation buffer awaiting a decision.

processor_dynamic_sampling_traces_droppe.description: Number of traces that were dropped, labelled by the rule that selected them.

processor_dynamic_sampling_traces_evicte.description: Number of traces evicted from the buffer before a decision could be made.

processor_dynamic_sampling_traces_sample.description: Number of traces that were sampled, labelled by the rule that selected them.
